request.text: I'm about to review my day. Look at me, blink once, and then say that my first priority is submitting the rent receipt and my second is buying groceries.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user before beginning the spoken priority review.
Blink once after looking at the user.
After the two body actions, state that submitting the rent receipt is the first priority and buying groceries is the second.

semantic_facts: The plan must preserve the three-stage order: look at the user, blink once, then speak the two priorities in their stated first-to-second order.
The spoken portion is an immediate recap of user-supplied priorities, not a request to create reminders or complete either errand.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the rent receipt was submitted or the groceries were purchased.
The assistant walks, reorders the responsibilities, reverses the priorities, or claims either body action completed without Capability evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The planner loses one responsibility when coordinating multiple embodied and spoken outputs.
The planner confuses reciting an ordered priority list with executing or scheduling the listed errands.
